workshop-fighter+toes.made: PPO over the timed punch, the toed Warrior's both hands at 120 and 480 Hz, 55.0M decisions in all (research/run-train.py, research/punch-learning-environment.mjs): 44.4M on the still rung with its legs' outputs as pushes, then on with them as asks of the legs (the heading and the centre), with walks in from 1.6 to 3 m beside the still places, halting the walk as it commits from 45.8M; the target up to 0.15 m across the body and 0.3 m to the hand's side, aimed at the trunk's surface square to the striking shoulder; admitted 0.89 to 1.01 m from the target, within 0.17 m of the striking shoulder's line at contact, at the middle mark's height; a drive that has met nothing ends after 0.3 s; then its layout widened by the gait's phase read and the walk kept or halted, their weights zero, so it plays as before; then on to 55.0M with the legs' unmet asks weighed (-1 a field a second) and 480 Hz drawn two times in three (research/environments/punch.json)

workshop-rogue+toes.made: The toed Warrior's settings (this file's workshop-fighter+toes), steered by a network trained by PPO on the Warrior's environment (research/environments/punch.json) with the Rogue in his place and its places' gaps scaled by 0.92, from the Warrior's network with its outputs scaled by a quarter (4 M decisions); held out, 69 of 100 landed at 120 Hz and 64 at 480 Hz, and on fresh trials 65 and 71, none fallen, at the Rogue's scaled bar (barOf, src/evaluation/strike/read.ts).
